summary: Mangoceuticals, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an ordinary shelf takedown, offering 657,000 shares of common stock paired with 657,000 common warrants at a combined public price of $0.75 per share and warrant, raising $492,750 before expenses. Each warrant has a $1.00 exercise price, is immediately exercisable, and expires five years from issuance; shares underlie up to 788,400 shares on cashless exercise. Nasdaq-listed MGRX closed at $0.44 on October 7, 2026; delivery expected October 9, 2026. This is not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang.
